report_name: Data of 8.7M Customers Exposed in Manchester Airports Group Breach

identities.name: Manchester Airports Group
identities.description: A major UK airport operator of Manchester, Stansted, and East Midlands airports, which suffered a data breach affecting 8.7 million customers of its ancillary services like car parking and airport lounges.

indicators.name: Potential SQL Injection Attempt on Booking Portal
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential SQL Injection Attempt on Booking Portal
id: 2b8a1c9d-5e6f-4a3b-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects web requests containing common SQL injection patterns targeting booking portals, such as '/ManageMyBooking'.
references:
  - https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/08/28/manchester-airports-group-data-breach/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-29
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: high
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection_sqli:
    c-uri|contains:
      - 'UNION SELECT'
      - "' OR 1=1"
      - ' OR 1=1--'
      - ' OR 1=1# '
      - ' OR 1=1/*'
  selection_path:
    c-uri|contains: '/ManageMyBooking'
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects web requests containing common SQL injection patterns targeting booking portals, based on hunting hints provided in the article.
